box_def.bbox: [x0, y0, x1, y1] image pixels of the clip frame (1920x1080)
box_def.carrier: the v6 holder at the nearest 10 Hz sample, only in state carry
box_def.names: name/shirt only within track B's names_live_0 windows; track_id never on screen
box_def.team: home | away | referee | null (kit matches neither team: unassigned)
box_def.team_rule: the v6 rule per observation (track B's hand fix, else keeper by the goal he stands in, else kit colour), then held per identity stretch of the track so a one-sample kit flicker does not flip a box's colour; a flip that holds three samples or a jump no player can run is a new stretch (an ID switch), as in v6.identity_span.
box_def.tracking: measured = the tracker's own boxes at this frame; interpolated = linear between the two neighbouring samples (one tracker step apart, same camera shot), only for tracks seen on both; lost = no box (lost_reason says why)
